verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents dedicated bulk endpoints, including bulk subscriber creation, bulk updates of custom field values for many subscribers in one request, and bulk custom field creation. Large batches are processed asynchronously, with a `callback_url` POSTed when processing completes, and broadcast stats can be fetched for a whole page in one call. Kit itself says bulk support covers only "some common use cases" and requires OAuth. Missing for 10: bulk coverage beyond select resources (e.g. bulk tagging/deletion), evidence that bulk actions are exposed through the Kit MCP for AI clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
